description: Create a draft post for a creator space after the user approves exact content. Defaults to LinkedIn; pass platform=x for X drafts. Supports first comments and media fields.

funnel_plan.description: Optional funnel intent from a funnel plan (bamf.get_funnel_mix). Stored as generation_metadata.funnel_plan.

platform.description: Case-insensitive; aliases li, x/twitter, ig accepted. Stored as LinkedIn, Twitter, Instagram, Threads, TikTok, YouTube or Facebook.

sources.description: Optional provenance for the draft: where this post idea came from (a research artifact, the agent session that produced it, or a URL). Shown in post review.

captured_at.description: ISO8601 timestamp the source was captured.

session_id.description: Agent session that produced the source.

title.description: Label shown in post review, e.g. the artifact title.

name: bamf.create_post_draft
